notes: Replaces the earlier edit ('Canada's only land neighbour is the United States'). New symmetric, functional relation shares_longest_border_with (staged). Related near (the United States' side) is labelled functional: Canada's single longest-border partner is Mexico, and only one border is the longest (revision fact with check). Related far (composition) asks whether Alaska is part of the longest-border partner of Canada; the Wikipedia border article states the Alaska border and the longest-border claim together. Derived: composition twice (capital, Guatemala) and binding (the country whose capital is Ottawa). Indeterminate query: the longest undefended border; w1 (stored by name) assumes the Canada-Mexico border is defended, so a longer border does not take the description; w2 stores it as the longest international border. Negation uses the 'Is it true that X does not ...' form. Not done: the Rule 6 audit has not been re-run; Wikipedia answered HTTP 429 for the Mexico-Guatemala border, so 'Mexico borders Guatemala' has a count of 22 only; the nickname 'undefended border' may be missed by some models. related[1]: symmetry, the stored fact asked from the United States' side with a wh- question; after the edit no country is left (functional plus symmetric), so new_answer is 'none'. related[1] (2026-11-14): functional, the Canada-United States border asked as a thing (the stored superlative) rather than from the United States' side; a different statement from related[0], though borders have only one other-argument reading, so the two stay close.
